description: Check a connected domain now: the DNS TXT ownership proof (a verified domain becomes active; a manual check can never demote an already-active one), then whether visitors get the site — health.items: txt, address (the A record points at handoff's edge and nowhere else), ipv6 (no AAAA), https (a valid certificate at the edge, and its status) and serve (the serve chain rung by rung), each failing item with a fix. records lists exactly what to publish at the registrar (type, host, value).
